<!-- Generated by esquadro docs from the blueprint's manifest: do not edit. -->

A site rendered on the server, for people and search engines (a store's shop window, a site of offers), used by name: blueprint ssr site. Each entity marked @&lt;name>(page) gets a list (/&lt;path>, with the filters, order, search and pages the store allows) and a page per record (/&lt;path>/&lt;id>/&lt;slug>), with titles, descriptions, Open Graph, structured data, a sitemap and robots.txt. People read what @security(read ...) lets them: everyone what is public, and who signs in to the realm of auth what that realm may. What is generated is regenerated; the layout, the pages, the words and the styles are yours, written once and merged with esquadro's changes. With engine go, the app's binary renders it (templ, htmx and Tailwind).

```esquadro
blueprint ssr
```

## Works with

- **Requires** [app](../app/), [http](../http/), [store](../store/), [security](../security/), [workspace](../workspace/), [ui](../ui/): the app must use them too.

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `engine` | name | `"go"` | What renders the site: go (the app's binary, with templ), the only one so far. |
| `domain` | string | `""` | The domain it answers on (shop.com); without one, the app's domain, under path. |
| `path` | string | `""` | Its path on the app's domain, when it has no domain of its own; /&lt;name> by default. |
| `auth` | string | `""` | The realm whose people sign in to it; the first realm by default. |
| `roles` | list | `[]` | The roles of the realm let in to its pages that need a session; any role when empty. |
| `locale` | name | `"en"` | en or pt_br: the language of its words and of dates, numbers and money. |
| `serve` | name | `"app"` | app: the app's binary serves it. |
| `name` | string | `""` | The site's name: in every title and in Open Graph; the app's label by default. |
| `url` | string | `""` | The site's address, for canonical links, Open Graph and the sitemap: https://shop.com; https://&lt;domain> by default. |
| `page_size` | int | `24` | How many records a list shows at a time. |
| `primary` | string | `"#2a85ff"` | The primary color (buttons, links), as #rrggbb. |
| `primary_dark` | string | `""` | The primary color of the dark theme; by default the primary, or a light gray when the primary is too dark to stand out there. |
| `radius` | string | `"0.75rem"` | How round the corners are, as CSS: 0.75rem, 0.5rem, 0. |
| `brand` | string | `""` | The project's folder of its brand, with its theme.json (colors, fonts, text roles, radii, buttons, motion, the pictures of the states) and the files it names (logo, favicon, fonts): brand. The site takes its look and identity from it, in place of primary and radius, and serves its files at /brand/ (the icons' at the root too). |

```esquadro
blueprint ssr {
  engine "go"
}
```

## Environment variables

Read when the app starts; see [Environment variables](/esquadro/language/environment/).

| Variable | Type | Value | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `INSTANCE_VISITOR_SECRET` | string, secret, required outside development | generated in development | The key a visit of a redirect is told apart by, a day at a time, without keeping who it is (edge.Visitor): with a redirect. |

## Annotations

| Where | Key | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| entity | `page` | bool | The entity has pages: a list at /&lt;path>, and one per record. |
| entity | `redirect` | bool | Its records redirect: /&lt;path>/&lt;by> (at the root without a path) sends to the address in &lt;to>. &lt;entity>_rules.go decides where each visit goes (BeforeRedirect) and what is kept of it (Visited). |
| entity | `by` | name | The unique field a record is found by, with redirect: code. |
| entity | `to` | name | The field of the address a record sends to, with redirect: target_url. |
| entity | `wait` | int | With redirect, the seconds (1 to 10) a person sees a page of where they are going (&lt;entity>_redirect.templ) before going on; bots go on at once. |
| entity | `path` | string | The part of the address: ofertas. Its plural, in kebab case, by default. |
| entity | `title` | name | The field a record is called by, in titles and its address; the first text field by default. |
| entity | `description` | name | The field of a record's description, for search engines and shared links. |
| entity | `image` | name | The image field of a record's picture, for its page and shared links. |
| entity | `schema` | name | The structured data of its pages: product, article or organization. |
| entity | `sort` | string | The order of its list: -created_at, price. |
| entity | `relations` | list | Relations whose records its page lists: [offers]. |
| entity | `menu` | bool | An entry in the site's menu. |
| entity | `og_image` | bool | Each record's page gets an Open Graph image drawn by the app, /&lt;path>/&lt;id>/og.png (1200x630), with blueprint images: drawn by &lt;entity>_og.go, yours, and kept in the store until the record changes. |
| entity | `label` | string | What this site calls it, when not what @ui says. |
| entity | `singular` | string | What one of it is called on this site, when not what @ui says. |
| field | `label` | string | What this site calls the field, when not what @ui says. |
| field | `hidden` | bool | Leave the field out of the site. |
| relation | `label` | string | What this site calls the relation, when not what @ui says. |
| value | `label` | string | What this site calls the value, when not what @ui says. |

An annotation is written `@ssr(key value)` on the element.

- `post-gen` templ, writes `web/**/*_templ.go`
